chapterInfo.content:
9
1 # Yer 13.17; Kwa 1.16 O sɛ me tiri yɛɛ nsuo
na m’ani yɛɛ nisuo abura a,
anka mɛsu me man babaa wuo no awia ne anadwo.
2Sɛ merenya akwantemfoɔ asoɛeɛ
wɔ anwea pradada so ɛ!
Anka mɛgya me man hɔ,
na mafiri wɔn nkyɛn makɔ!
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nyinaa yɛ awaresɛefoɔ,
nkɔnkɔnsafoɔ asafo.
3Na wɔkuntunu wɔn tɛkyerɛma de yɛ wɔn tadua
atorɔ na ɛnyɛ nokorɛ na atim wɔ asase no so,
na wɔfiri bɔne mu kɔ bɔne mu,
na me deɛ, wɔnnim me, AWURADE asɛm nie.
4 # Mika 7.5-6 Monhwɛ mo ho yie mo ayɔnkofoɔ ho,
na obiara mmfa ne ho nnto onua biara so,
na onua biara, nsisie ara na ɔsisie,
na ɔyɔnko biara nam di nsekuro.
5Na wɔn nyinaa twitwa wɔn mfɛfoɔ nkontompo,
na nokorɛ deɛ, wɔnka.
Wɔma atorosɛm ka kokwa wɔn tɛkyerɛma so,
wɔdi abɔnefosɛm, na wɔnnu wɔn ho.
6Wo tenabea wɔ nnaadaa ntam; nnaadaa nti
wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔhu me, AWURADE asɛm nie.
7Enti sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie:
Hwɛ, mɛnane wɔn na masɔ wɔn mahwɛ,
na menyɛ dɛn, me man babaa no ho?
8Wɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ agyan a ɛkum nipa,
nnaadaasɛm na ɛka;
wɔde wɔn ano ka asomdwoeɛsɛm kyerɛ ɔyɔnko,
na wɔn mu deɛ, wɔtetɛ no.
9 # Yer 5.9 Meremmɛtwe wɔn aso wɔ yei nti anaa? AWURADE asɛm nie,
anaasɛ me kra rentɔ
ɔman a wɔte sɛɛ no so were?
10 # Yer 4.25; 12.4 Mmepɔ no nti, metue esu ne benabɔ mu,
na ɛserɛ so adidibea no nti, meto esu dwom,
ɛfiri sɛ ahye na obiara mfa hɔ,
na wɔnte mmoakuo nne bio,
ewiem nnomaa ne afieboa nyinaa atutu kɔ.
11 # Yer 26.18 Na mɛyɛ Yerusalem nkunkumaboɔ akuakuo,
ɛserɛ so kraman tenabea,
na madane Yuda nkuro amamfo
a obiara nte hɔ.
12 # Deut 32.29 Hwan ne ɔba nyansafoɔ a ɔbɛte yei aseɛ? Na hwan ne deɛ AWURADE ano akasa akyerɛ no a ɔbɛka? Ɛdeɛn nti na asase no asɛeɛ, ahye sɛ ɛserɛ, na obiara mfa soɔ? 13Na AWURADE se: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔagya me mmara a mede mesii wɔn anim, na wɔantie me, na wɔannante mu ntira. 14#Yer 7.24 Na wɔdii wɔn akoma denyɛ akyi ne Baalim akyi, sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom kyerɛɛ wɔn no. 15#Yer 23.15 Enti sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn no seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede ɔnwono bɛma ɔman yi adi, na mede nsuo a ɛborɔ wɔ mu ama wɔanom. 16#Lew 26.33 Na mɛbɔ wɔn apete amanaman a wɔne wɔn agyanom nhunuu wɔn da mu, na mama afena adi wɔn akyi akɔsi sɛ mɛwie wɔn sɛeɛ.
Yerusalem su pɛ mmoa
17Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie:
Monnwene ho na momfrɛ mmaa a wɔnim su mmra,
na monsoma ma wɔnkɔhyia mmaa anyansafoɔ na wɔmmra,
18na wɔnyɛ ntɛm ntue yɛn ho su,
na yɛn ani mporepore nisuo,
na yɛn anisuatɛtɛ nsene nsuo.
19Na wɔte esu nka firi Sion:
Sɛdeɛ yɛasi asɛe afa!
Yɛn ani awu pii,
ɛfiri sɛ yɛagya asase no,
na wɔasunsum yɛn tenabea agu.
20Na mo mmaa, montie AWURADE asɛm,
na n’anomu asɛm nkɔ mo aso mu,
na monkyerɛ mo mmammaa su
na monkyerɛkyerɛ mo ho kwadwom.
21Na owuo aforo afa yɛn mpomma mu,
waforo aba yɛn aban fɛfɛ mu,
sɛ ɛbɛtwa mmotafowa afiri mmorɔno so
ne mmeranteɛ afiri mmɔntene so.
22 # Yer 7.33 Ka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Nnipa afunu bɛgugu hɔ
sɛ mfuo so nwira dodoɔ,
sɛ ayutwafoɔ akyiri afiafi,
na obiara remmoa ano.
23Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mma onyansafoɔ nnhyehyɛ ne ho ne nyansa ho, na ɔhoɔdenfoɔ nnhyehyɛ ne ho n’ahoɔden ho, na ɔdefoɔ nso nnhyehyɛ ne ho n’ahodeɛ ho, 24#1 Ko 1.31; 2 Ko 10.17 na yei ho mmom na ma deɛ ɔhyehyɛ ne ho no nhyehyɛ ne ho, sɛ ɔnim de, na wahu me, sɛ mene AWURADE a ɔyɛ adɔeɛ, na ɔbu atɛntenenee, yɛ adetenenee, asase soɔ, na yei na ɛsɔ m’ani, AWURADE asɛm nie.
25Hwɛ, nna bi reba, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, a mɛba mabɛtwe twetiafoɔ a wɔatena ase sɛ momonotofoɔ no nyinaa aso, 26#Lew 19.27; Yer 4.4; Deut 30.6 Misraimfoɔ, Yudafoɔ, Edomfoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Moabfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔtete anwea pradada soɔ na wɔatwitwa wɔn nwi de di awufoɔ nni nyinaa; ɛfiri sɛ amanaman yi nyinaa yɛ momonotofoɔ, na Israel fie nyinaa yɛ akoma mu momonotofoɔ.

O sɛ me tiri yɛɛ nsuo
na m’ani yɛɛ nisuo abura a,
anka mɛsu me man babaa wuo no awia ne anadwo.
Sɛ merenya akwantemfoɔ asoɛeɛ
wɔ anwea pradada so ɛ!
Anka mɛgya me man hɔ,
na mafiri wɔn nkyɛn makɔ!
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nyinaa yɛ awaresɛefoɔ,
nkɔnkɔnsafoɔ asafo.
Na wɔkuntunu wɔn tɛkyerɛma de yɛ wɔn tadua
atorɔ na ɛnyɛ nokorɛ na atim wɔ asase no so,
na wɔfiri bɔne mu kɔ bɔne mu,
na me deɛ, wɔnnim me, AWURADE asɛm nie.

Monhwɛ mo ho yie mo ayɔnkofoɔ ho,
na obiara mmfa ne ho nnto onua biara so,
na onua biara, nsisie ara na ɔsisie,
na ɔyɔnko biara nam di nsekuro.
Na wɔn nyinaa twitwa wɔn mfɛfoɔ nkontompo,
na nokorɛ deɛ, wɔnka.
Wɔma atorosɛm ka kokwa wɔn tɛkyerɛma so,
wɔdi abɔnefosɛm, na wɔnnu wɔn ho.
Wo tenabea wɔ nnaadaa ntam; nnaadaa nti
wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔhu me, AWURADE asɛm nie.

Enti sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie:
Hwɛ, mɛnane wɔn na masɔ wɔn mahwɛ,
na menyɛ dɛn, me man babaa no ho?
Wɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ agyan a ɛkum nipa,
nnaadaasɛm na ɛka;
wɔde wɔn ano ka asomdwoeɛsɛm kyerɛ ɔyɔnko,
na wɔn mu deɛ, wɔtetɛ no.
Meremmɛtwe wɔn aso wɔ yei nti anaa? AWURADE asɛm nie,
anaasɛ me kra rentɔ
ɔman a wɔte sɛɛ no so were?

Mmepɔ no nti, metue esu ne benabɔ mu,
na ɛserɛ so adidibea no nti, meto esu dwom,
ɛfiri sɛ ahye na obiara mfa hɔ,
na wɔnte mmoakuo nne bio,
ewiem nnomaa ne afieboa nyinaa atutu kɔ.
Na mɛyɛ Yerusalem nkunkumaboɔ akuakuo,
ɛserɛ so kraman tenabea,
na madane Yuda nkuro amamfo
a obiara nte hɔ.

Hwan ne ɔba nyansafoɔ a ɔbɛte yei aseɛ? Na hwan ne deɛ AWURADE ano akasa akyerɛ no a ɔbɛka? Ɛdeɛn nti na asase no asɛeɛ, ahye sɛ ɛserɛ, na obiara mfa soɔ? Na AWURADE se: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔagya me mmara a mede mesii wɔn anim, na wɔantie me, na wɔannante mu ntira. Na wɔdii wɔn akoma denyɛ akyi ne Baalim akyi, sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom kyerɛɛ wɔn no. Enti sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn no seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede ɔnwono bɛma ɔman yi adi, na mede nsuo a ɛborɔ wɔ mu ama wɔanom. Na mɛbɔ wɔn apete amanaman a wɔne wɔn agyanom nhunuu wɔn da mu, na mama afena adi wɔn akyi akɔsi sɛ mɛwie wɔn sɛeɛ.

Sɛ asafo AWURADE seɛ nie:
Monnwene ho na momfrɛ mmaa a wɔnim su mmra,
na monsoma ma wɔnkɔhyia mmaa anyansafoɔ na wɔmmra,
na wɔnyɛ ntɛm ntue yɛn ho su,
na yɛn ani mporepore nisuo,
na yɛn anisuatɛtɛ nsene nsuo.
Na wɔte esu nka firi Sion:
Sɛdeɛ yɛasi asɛe afa!
Yɛn ani awu pii,
ɛfiri sɛ yɛagya asase no,
na wɔasunsum yɛn tenabea agu.
Na mo mmaa, montie AWURADE asɛm,
na n’anomu asɛm nkɔ mo aso mu,
na monkyerɛ mo mmammaa su
na monkyerɛkyerɛ mo ho kwadwom.
Na owuo aforo afa yɛn mpomma mu,
waforo aba yɛn aban fɛfɛ mu,
sɛ ɛbɛtwa mmotafowa afiri mmorɔno so
ne mmeranteɛ afiri mmɔntene so.
Ka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Nnipa afunu bɛgugu hɔ
sɛ mfuo so nwira dodoɔ,
sɛ ayutwafoɔ akyiri afiafi,
na obiara remmoa ano.
Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mma onyansafoɔ nnhyehyɛ ne ho ne nyansa ho, na ɔhoɔdenfoɔ nnhyehyɛ ne ho n’ahoɔden ho, na ɔdefoɔ nso nnhyehyɛ ne ho n’ahodeɛ ho, na yei ho mmom na ma deɛ ɔhyehyɛ ne ho no nhyehyɛ ne ho, sɛ ɔnim de, na wahu me, sɛ mene AWURADE a ɔyɛ adɔeɛ, na ɔbu atɛntenenee, yɛ adetenenee, asase soɔ, na yei na ɛsɔ m’ani, AWURADE asɛm nie.
Hwɛ, nna bi reba, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, a mɛba mabɛtwe twetiafoɔ a wɔatena ase sɛ momonotofoɔ no nyinaa aso, Misraimfoɔ, Yudafoɔ, Edomfoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Moabfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔtete anwea pradada soɔ na wɔatwitwa wɔn nwi de di awufoɔ nni nyinaa; ɛfiri sɛ amanaman yi nyinaa yɛ momonotofoɔ, na Israel fie nyinaa yɛ akoma mu momonotofoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
